notes: *no* is given to `לֹא` as the clause's negation recast onto the object nominal, exactly as rule 15 gives the *no* of `לֹא יֵעָשֶׂה לִמְלָאכָה` → *it was meet for no work* to the negative; `בַּרְזֶל` keeps its own *iron tool*.
`בַּרְזֶל` → *iron tool* heads on *iron* by rule 31's subtraction test, *tool* alone being any tool; the ASV italic corroborates without deciding (rule 7).
